raw_html: [[Legendary Taint of Shavarath]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Legendary Taint of Shavarath]]:''' Green Steel items thirst for pain and suffering. While weapons feed their bloodlust on enemies, accessories and clothing cannot. Wearing multiple items that bear the Legendary Taint of Shavarath creates dangerous imbalances of energy as the items feed more and more upon the wielder. Perhaps there is a way to appease this item...
